card.title: Assistant
card.description: A local AI model (LM Studio on a PC in the house) that answers questions and does things with the app's own actions. Also over MCP for other assistants.

problem.invalid_url: ASSISTANT_BASE_URL is not a valid http(s) URL.

setup.intro: The assistant runs on your own computer with LM Studio. On that PC:
setup.install: Install LM Studio and download a model with tool support, e.g. Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct or Qwen 3 8B (Q4_K_M fits 8 GB of video memory).
setup.serve: Developer tab → load the model → Settings: switch on “Serve on Local Network” and Start the server (port 1234). Give the PC a fixed IP address in the router.
setup.model: The model's identifier exactly as LM Studio shows it, e.g. qwen2.5-7b-instruct
setup.stt: Optional: a local Whisper server for voice (OpenAI-compatible), e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8000/v1
setup.restart: Restart the app so it reads the new settings
setup.tts: Optional: a speech server for a natural voice when reading answers aloud, e.g. Piper on this server: http://127.0.0.1:5005
setup.search: Optional: a search server on this server so the assistant can search the internet (ai/docs/WEB-SEARCH.md), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8888

card.voiceUnreachable: Speech server ({{host}}) isn't answering: browser's voice for now

webProblem.invalid_url: SEARCH_URL is not a valid http(s) URL; web search is off.

ttsProblem.invalid_url: ASSISTANT_TTS_URL is not a valid http(s) URL; the browser's voice is used.
ttsProblem.invalid_kind: ASSISTANT_TTS_KIND must be piper or openai; the browser's voice is used.
ttsProblem.invalid_speed: ASSISTANT_TTS_SPEED must be a number from 0.5 to 2; the normal speed is used.

tokens.title: MCP access
tokens.description: Let another assistant on the network (Claude Desktop, LM Studio, Home Assistant…) use the same actions as you, with a personal token.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.scopeWrite: Read and change (each change needs confirm: true)
tokens.createdDescription: Copy it now: it is shown only once. Use it as “Authorization: Bearer …”.
tokens.revokeDescription: Assistants using this token lose access at once.
tokens.loadFailed: The tokens could not be loaded.

cleanup.title: Assistant: clean up old conversations
cleanup.description: Deletes assistant conversations without activity for 90 days.

oauthCleanup.title: Assistant: clean up OAuth
oauthCleanup.description: Removes expired OAuth codes and tokens, and self-registered apps unused for an hour without a connection.

connect.title: Connect other assistants (MCP)
connect.description: Other assistants can use the same actions as you, as you. Pick the way your assistant supports.

when.token: for Claude Desktop, LM Studio, Cursor and other clients where you paste a token yourself.
when.dcr: for ChatGPT and Claude connectors: they register themselves and you allow them on a WickedHome page.
when.app: for a connector that asks for a client ID (and secret) instead of registering itself.

oauth.loadFailed: The OAuth connections could not be loaded.

connected.title: Connected apps
connected.empty: No apps connected over OAuth yet.
connected.revokeDescription: The app loses access for {{person}} at once; connecting again means allowing it again.

dcr.chatgpt: ChatGPT: Server URL {{url}}, Authentication OAuth, Registration automatic (DCR) — or make an OAuth app here and paste the client ID.
dcr.claude: Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, URL {{url}}.
dcr.switchHelp: Off: new apps can't register themselves. Apps already connected and personal tokens keep working.
dcr.hostsHelp: Apps that register themselves may only send tokens to these domains (exact names, one per line), e.g. chatgpt.com.
dcr.noHosts: None: no app can register itself.
dcr.ownerOnly: An owner of the household manages automatic registration and its domains.

apps.title: OAuth apps
apps.howTo: Make an app here, then in the connector choose OAuth with manual registration and paste the client ID (and the secret, if you made one).
apps.createDescription: The client ID and secret are shown once, right after saving.
apps.name: Name
apps.redirectUrisHelp: The callback URL(s) the connector shows, one per line; https only.
apps.confidentialHelp: For connectors that keep a secret on their server. Without it the app uses PKCE only.
apps.createdWithSecret: Copy the secret now: it is shown only once.
apps.createdPublic: Paste this client ID in the connector. There is no secret (PKCE only).
apps.deleteDescription: Everyone connected through this app loses access at once.
apps.ownerOnly: Only an owner of the household can make OAuth apps.

errors.invalidHost: Use exact domain names such as chatgpt.com (no https://, no paths).
errors.invalidRedirectUri: Every line must be an https URL without #.
errors.redirectUriRequired: Give at least one redirect URI.

consent.title: {{client}} wants access to WickedHome
consent.onlyIfYou: Only allow this if you just started connecting from {{host}} yourself.
consent.readDescription: See your household's data, change nothing.
consent.writeDescription: Also add and change things; {{client}} must ask you before every change.
consent.dataNote: What you share with {{client}} goes to that service and is handled under its terms. You can disconnect it any time on the Assistant card.
consent.childRefused: Child accounts can't connect apps. Ask an adult of the household.
consent.failed: That didn't work. Reload the page and try again.
consent.expiredDescription: Start connecting again from the app you came from.
